children.name: Urodasys toxostylis
children.description: Trunk of adult specimen being described Lt 440 µm (others Lt 413 - 480); Lt tail 1100 µm (others Lt 588 - 1620); LPh 174 µm (others LPh 161 - 173) to PhJIn at U 40 (others PhJIn at U 34 - U 40) (Fig. 12 A, B). Trunk medium in length as an adult, ventrally flattened, dorsally vaulted; head bluntly ovate, with a narrow band of circumcephalic cilia and broad pestle organs at U 05; neck constriction slight; trunk broadest along the mid-gut, narrowing gradually in the hind-gut region to the elongate tail. Widths at pestle organs / pharyngeal pores / PhJIn / front, rear of caudal organ, and locations along the length of the body are as follows: 46 / 48 / 50 / 54,30 µm at U 03 / U 33 / U 46 / U 72,97, respectively. Glands 15 - 16 per side (4 - 7 µm), larger in front than behind.
